text:
This is a short tour of the Crewflow web
console, using fictional demonstration

The Dashboard summarises your staff,
offers, shifts and attendance. Every card
links to the page behind it.

The sidebar is grouped. The main pages are
at the top, Operations holds Calendar,

Venues and Venue Offers, and Workspace
holds the Audit Log, Help Center and

Users lists your staff, and the venue
managers who work at your venues.

Shifts shows every shift, how many places
are filled, and its status.

Offers tracks each offer you have sent,
and how staff have responded.

Venue Offers lists staffing requests and
shifts, each with its own staffing board.

The calendar shows the month ahead. Select
a day to see its shifts.

Press the forward slash key at any time to
search people, venues, shifts and offers.

And Help Center has short guides to
everyday tasks.
